label: Ground temperature at 1 m, mid-century
description: GIPL 2.0 mean annual ground temperature at 1 m
method: Mean annual ground temperature at 1 m depth from GIPL 2.0 (SNAP, 1 km EPSG:3338), 5-model average, RCP 4.5, averaged over climate years 2040–2069. The GIPL files are labelled 20 years late (file year = climate year + 20). Cells with stuck GIPL values, and a 2 km border around them, are removed (no value).
author: Joshdpaul
